# www.3m.com llms.txt

> 3M applies science and innovation to make a real impact by igniting progress and inspiring innovation in lives and communities across the globe.

## Main

- [3M Cleaning Supplies](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/cleaning-supplies): Showcase 3M cleaning supplies and related products for commercial and industrial use.
- [3M Abrasives](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/abrasives): Showcase 3M abrasive products and solutions for various industrial and craft applications.
- [3M Product Catalog](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p): Showcase 3M product catalog and company information for customers and partners.
- [3M Lubricants](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/lubricants): Showcase 3M's lubricant products and categories for industrial and commercial use.
- [3M Brands Overview](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/company-us/our-brands): Showcase 3M brands and products across various industries and consumer markets.
- [3M Advanced Materials](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/advanced-materials): Showcase 3M's advanced materials portfolio for industrial and technological applications.
- [3M Home Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/home): Showcase 3M products and solutions for home organization, storage, and surface protection.
- [3M Tools & Equipment](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/tools-equipment): Showcase 3M tools and equipment for industrial and professional use.
- [Select Your Location](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/select-location): Redirects visitors to localized 3M websites based on geographic regions and languages.
- [3M Site Map](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/company-us/site-map): Provides a comprehensive site map and navigation options for 3M's US website.
- [3M Adhesives & Sealants](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/adhesives): Showcase 3M adhesives and sealants product offerings and details.
- [3M Compounds & Polishes](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/compounds-polishes): Showcase 3M's polishing and compound products for industrial, automotive, marine, and aerospace finishing needs.
- [3M Tapes Overview](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/tapes): Showcase different types of 3M tapes and their applications.
- [3M Automotive Solutions](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/automotive-us): Showcase 3M's automotive solutions, products, markets, and company information for industry professionals.
- [Login Assistance](https://www.3m.com/my3M/en_US/company-us): Instructs users on enabling JavaScript and cookies to access the 3M account services.
- [3M Automotive Parts](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/automotive-parts-hardware): Showcase 3M automotive parts and hardware products with details and purchasing options.
- [3M Office Supplies](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/office-supplies): Showcase and sell office supplies and related products for business and personal use.
- [3M Coatings Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/coatings): Showcase 3M coatings products and their specifications for industrial and commercial applications.
- [3M Corporate Site](https://www.3m.com): Showcase 3M's diverse product solutions and corporate information.
- [3M Films & Sheeting](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/films-sheeting): Showcase 3M films and sheeting products for various applications and industries.
- [Lab Supplies & Testing](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/lab-supplies-testing): Showcase 3M lab testing supplies, including oil quality test strips, and provide product details and purchasing options.
- [3M Corporate Solutions](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US): Showcase 3M's diverse product solutions and company information for various industries and stakeholders.
- [3M Signage & Marking](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/signage-marking): Showcase 3M signage and marking products, services, and resources for various applications.
- [3M Insulation Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/insulation): Showcase 3M insulation products and their applications in various industries.
- [3M Building Materials](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/building-materials): Showcase 3M building materials and solutions for construction and industry needs.
- [3M Filtration & Separation](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/filtration-separation): Showcase filtration and separation products for water, air, and process applications with product details and categories.
- [3M Medical Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/medical): Showcase 3M's medical products and solutions for healthcare professionals.
- [3M Electrical Solutions](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/electrical): Showcase electrical products, solutions, and resources for construction and management professionals.
- [3M PPE Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/ppe): Showcase 3M's personal protective equipment products and resources for industry safety solutions.
- [3M Labels and Products](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/labels): Displays 3M labels and products for business procurement and information.
- [3M Electronics Components](https://www.3m.com/3M/en_US/p/c/electronics-components): Showcase 3M electronics components and solutions for various industries.

<!-- Update 2/18/2026 by AC -->
